title: Paired cross-platform transcriptomic analysis with dual-cohort validation identifies recurrent tissue-level alterations in hepatocellular carcinoma: research compendium
description: Public research compendium containing HCC analysis protocols, derived discovery and validation tables, explicit identifier-harmonization and denominator audits, donor-level single-cell sensitivity outputs, figure source data, executable workflows, environment specifications and integrity checks. Third-party raw data are not redistributed or relicensed. Original code is licensed under MIT; original derived data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
